# GNU cut

Pinned local vendor copy from `C:/msys64/usr/bin/cut.exe`. Active payload lives directly under `tools/toolbelt/third_party/cut`. Runtime DLLs are resolved through `vendor.msys2.runtime.usr` in `tools/toolbelt/libraries`.

This package belongs to the MSYS2 usr GNU coreutils family and intentionally uses the same direct `third_party/<tool>/bin/<tool>.exe` layout as the existing MSYS2 GNU tools.
